scientific_question: Do the sealed v149 deployment-visible group/set features place cross-trajectory canonical block-Krylov targets in a locally transferable neighborhood, or is the v149 miss already explained by feature-space support or conditional ambiguity?
scope: Post-open mechanism audit on the same five opened PoolFire trajectories. It is not a deployable predictor, physical replay, exact-call reduction, wall/RSS result, external test, curved-ray result, or real BOST result.

superseded_attempt.failure: plain projected gradient did not reach the unchanged 1e-9 fixed-point stationarity threshold within 4096 iterations
superseded_attempt.amendment_scope: replace only the convex numerical iteration with monotone-restart accelerated projected gradient; all inputs, neighbors, support definitions, methods, gates, thresholds, decision order, and claim limits remain unchanged

visible_metric.feature: the sealed v149 61-value local group feature augmented by per-sample active-group mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum to width 305
visible_metric.fit_only_normalization: v149 weighted mean and standard deviation with each sample carrying unit total weight across its active groups
visible_metric.distance: root-mean-square Euclidean distance in all 305 fit-standardized feature coordinates
visible_metric.geometry_handling: reported target-camera pose remains inside the metric; target camera slot is not matched so the audit remains camera-permutation equivariant
visible_metric.candidate_policy: for every held-out active group, take the exact two nearest rows from each of the four fit trajectories in the same camera-count/component stratum
visible_metric.distance_tie_break: ascending exact distance then ascending global active-row integer index

fit_support_reference.row_selection: sort global active-row integer indices and select deterministic evenly spaced midpoint ranks; use all rows when fewer than 64
fit_support_reference.reference_neighbor: nearest row from a different fit trajectory in the same camera-count/component stratum
fit_support_reference.support_threshold: fit-only higher 90th percentile of reference RMS distances
fit_support_reference.supported_heldout_row: held-out nearest RMS distance is at most the fold/stratum support threshold

frozen_methods.nearest_cross_trajectory_control: copy the canonical coordinates of the closest of the eight target-blind neighbors and apply the held-out canonical degree mask
frozen_methods.trajectory_balanced_idw_control: use the closest row from each fit trajectory, weighted by inverse RMS distance with floor 1e-6, and apply the held-out canonical degree mask
frozen_methods.best_bank_member_oracle: truth-aware diagnostic only: choose the candidate with minimum full-action scale-invariant relative L2, then maximum cosine, then lowest frozen candidate slot after all eight neighbors are fixed
frozen_methods.local_convex_hull_oracle: truth-aware diagnostic only: project the held-out normalized 96-direction target onto the simplex convex hull of the eight frozen candidate actions using a fixed deterministic projected-gradient solve

convex_solver.algorithm: monotone-restart accelerated projected gradient on the eight-weight simplex
convex_solver.step_size: reciprocal of the largest eigenvalue of the eight-by-eight candidate Gram matrix, with floor 1e-12

diagnostics.row_target_disagreement: scale-invariant relative L2 and cosine between held-out group coordinates and the closest neighbor after the held-out degree mask
diagnostics.conditional_conflict: a supported row with relative L2 above 0.45 or cosine below 0.9
diagnostics.local_lipschitz_demand: closest-neighbor group directional chord distance divided by RMS feature distance floored at 1e-12

non_exchangeable_decision_rule: If parent bindings, deterministic exact-neighbor construction, fit-only normalization, convex stationarity, scoring, or independent recomputation is invalid, return INCONCLUSIVE_CONDITIONAL_AMBIGUITY_V150.
If nearest_cross_trajectory_control passes the full-action gate, return HEADROOM_CHEAP_NEAREST_CONTROL_V150 and prefer it over a learned model.
Else if trajectory_balanced_idw_control passes, return HEADROOM_CHEAP_BALANCED_IDW_CONTROL_V150 and prefer it over a learned model.
Else if best_bank_member_oracle passes, return HEADROOM_LOCAL_MEMBER_SELECTION_ONLY_V150; this permits one later result-before-frozen stable selector but not a large model or GPU.
Else if local_convex_hull_oracle passes, return HEADROOM_LOCAL_CONVEX_COVERAGE_ONLY_V150; this permits one later result-before-frozen small continuous predictor but not a large model or GPU.
Else if any trajectory-camera-count supported fraction is below 0.9, return FAIL_CROSS_TRAJECTORY_FEATURE_SUPPORT_V150 and close the current visible feature state.
Else return FAIL_LOCAL_TARGET_COVERAGE_V150 and close the current visible feature state because even the truth-aware local convex lower bound fails under supported cross-trajectory neighborhoods.

authorization_after_independent_validati.cheap_control_pass: retain the cheaper deterministic control and proceed only to a separately frozen physical replay
authorization_after_independent_validati.best_member_or_convex_only_pass: freeze at most one numerically stable small predictor family with complete-trajectory LOTO
authorization_after_independent_validati.support_or_local_coverage_failure: close the current v149 visible feature state and design a physically different deployment-visible state
